2/G.goal: Explain the foundational application domains and system categories of XR, including why XR is commercially promising and how VR systems are categorized by sensory blocking.
2/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundational overview of XR uses and VR system types, supporting later course work on XR hardware, software, human factors, and system development.

2/O1.goal: Explain why XR is commercially promising by describing its major current VR application domains.
2/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a basic map of where XR is applied, supporting later understanding of the technologies and development issues covered in the course.

2/O2.goal: Explain how VR systems are categorized as non-immersive, semi-immersive, or fully immersive according to their degree of sensory blocking.
2/O2.achieves: It gives the learner a foundational way to distinguish VR system types, supporting later study of XR hardware and immersive experience.
